sequenceParameterData.name: Lighting Control DO_CN
sequenceParameterData.description: Scheduled or conditional lighting control for Connect Module
analyticsName: Lighting Control DO - Control Mode (Schedule, Schedule with Auto Occupancy, Occupancy Mode, Vacancy Mode, Manual Mode)

parameters.name: Control Type

options.label: 6 - Schedule with Auto Occupancy Vacancy Mode

parameters.comments:
1. Schedule Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on during the building or zone's occupied schedule mode.
2 - Occupancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on based on occupancy detected by the zone or building occupancy sensor and turn off automatically when no occupancy is detected by the sensor after the configured time delay expires.
3-  Vacancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall be turned on manually by the user via a local switch and turn off automatically when no occupancy is detected by the sensor after the configured time delay expires.
4 - Schedule with Auto Occupancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on and remain energized during the occupied schedule mode. Outside of scheduled hours, the circuit shall transition to Auto-ON / Auto-OFF logic, turning on automatically based on occupancy detected by the sensor and turn off automatically when no occupancy is detected by the sensor after the configured time delay expires.
5 - Schedule with Auto Vacancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on and remain energized during the occupied schedule mode. Outside of scheduled hours, the circuit shall transition to Manual-ON / Auto-OFF logic, requiring a manual turn-on via a local switch and turning off automatically when the space is vacant and the time delay expires.
6 - Schedule with Auto Occupancy Vacancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on automatically upon detected occupancy during scheduled hours, and shall strictly require a manual turn-on via a local switch outside of scheduled hours, automatically turning off in both states when the space is vacant and the time delay expires.
7 - Manual Override Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on or off based on a manual command from the user via manual override switch, overriding all existing schedules and sensors.

parameters.name: Control Type

options.label: 6 - Schedule with Auto Occupancy Vacancy Mode

parameters.comments:
1. Schedule Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on during the building or zone's occupied schedule mode.
2 - Occupancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on based on occupancy detected by the zone or building occupancy sensor and turn off automatically when no occupancy is detected by the sensor after the configured time delay expires.
3-  Vacancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall be turned on manually by the user via a local switch and turn off automatically when no occupancy is detected by the sensor after the configured time delay expires.
4 - Schedule with Auto Occupancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on and remain energized during the occupied schedule mode. Outside of scheduled hours, the circuit shall transition to Auto-ON / Auto-OFF logic, turning on automatically based on occupancy detected by the sensor and turning off when the space is vacant.
5 - Schedule with Auto Vacancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on and remain energized during the occupied schedule mode. Outside of scheduled hours, the circuit shall transition to Manual-ON / Auto-OFF logic, requiring a manual turn-on via a local switch and turning off automatically when the space is vacant and the time delay expires.
6 - Schedule with Auto Occupancy Vacancy Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on automatically upon detected occupancy during scheduled hours, and shall strictly require a manual turn-on via a local switch outside of scheduled hours, automatically turning off in both states when the space is vacant and the time delay expires.
7 - Manual Override Mode = The lighting circuit shall turn on or off based on a manual command from the user via manual override switch, overriding all existing schedules and sensors.
